notes.title: AoT 1 Bug update/Patch!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/d4ca96f8985cfb796070f9153302c8fb9b848384.jpg[/img]

A patch was uploaded recently which should bring everyone's games up to date, as well as fixing some pathing issues.

This, children, is why you don't rush the process and you trust yourself and your vision and skills. You will find yourself putting out incredibly easily avoidable fires for your first game almost a decade later.
